description: This PHP source file defines the ResourceTypeBuildEvent class used for configuring the construction of JSON:API resource types within Drupal, including methods for creating, modifying, enabling, disabling, and retrieving resource type details.

classes.name: ResourceTypeBuildEvent
classes.description: An event class used to configure the creation and modification of JSON:API resource types in Drupal, providing methods to set resource type names, fields, and enable/disable resource types and fields.

methods.name: createFromEntityTypeAndBundle
methods.description: Creates a new ResourceTypeBuildEvent instance based on an entity type and bundle, combining their IDs with a separator.

methods.name: getResourceTypeName
methods.description: Returns the current resource type name.

methods.name: setResourceTypeName
methods.description: Sets the resource type name, which is also used to build the resource path.

methods.name: disableResourceType
methods.description: Disables the resource type to prevent it from being built.

methods.name: resourceTypeShouldBeDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the resource type is marked as disabled.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Retrieves the current list of resource type fields.

methods.name: setPublicFieldName
methods.description: Sets a public name for a specific resource type field.

methods.name: disableField
methods.description: Disables a specific resource type field.

methods.name: enableField
methods.description: Enables a specific resource type field.
